name: port_developers_tuning
description: The tuning (section 6). The shipped airport lists three types (small, medium, large: stage 0 configurations 0xCA2436C0, 0x6A5126D0, 0x0A512810). [quirk] A listed type whose exemplar is missing is not appended, so later types shift down; typeCount stays the list's length [choice: scans are bounded by the loaded count]. A type without a stage count is not loaded [choice]. Here the list is (small, missing, large, no stage count): two types load, and a large-airport lot adopts with type index 1. A tuning instance of 0 loads nothing.
